root_cause.text: The xhci debugfs portli handler dereferences port->rhub without a NULL check, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the number of port registers (xhci->max_ports) exceeds the number of ports reported by Supported Protocol capabilities, resulting in ports without an associated roothub.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL check for port->rhub before accessing it, and the commit message explicitly states: "In such cases port->rhub will be NULL so we can't reach xhci behind it. Add an explicit NULL check for this case."
